source: 上外版必修第三册 Unit 4 同主题完形(智能家居/在线学习/可穿戴健康设备/科技与老人/机器人比赛/数字时代的礼貌);用词限 U4/初中/常见词,答案唯一,4选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: A Smart Home
passages.text: My family recently turned our flat into a smart home, and it has changed our daily life. In the morning, the lights come on by (1)____ before I even open my eyes. I just say a word, and the speaker (2)____ to my voice and plays the news. The heating is (3)____, so the rooms are warm enough but never too hot. When I leave, a single tap on my phone can (4)____ off everything at once. Cameras let me (5)____ the front door from anywhere in the city. At first my grandmother (6)____ that all this was too complicated, but soon she learned to use it without any (7)____. Of course, the system is not (8)____. Once the Internet went down and nothing worked, which (9)____ me a little. Still, used (10)____, a smart home saves time and makes life more comfortable.

passages.title: Learning Online
passages.text: Last winter my school moved its lessons online, and I had to study from home through a screen. At first it was a real (1)____, because I missed sitting with my classmates. Slowly, though, I began to (4)____ some real advantages. I could (5)____ a recorded lesson again whenever I did not understand something. I no longer wasted time travelling, so I had (6)____ hours to read. Online study also asked me to be more (7)____: nobody stood beside me, so I had to (8)____ myself to follow the timetable. By the end of the term, I had become a far more (9)____ learner. Both kinds of study, I realised, have their own (10)____.

passages.title: A Watch That Watches You
passages.text: My new smartwatch does far more than tell the time. All day it quietly (1)____ how many steps I take and how fast my heart beats. passages.title: Grandpa and the Tablet
passages.text: When we gave Grandpa a tablet, he stared at it with a little (1)____, unsure where to begin. The bright screen did not (2)____ him at first, and he said the buttons were too small. We sat with him (3)____ and showed him, step by step, how to send a message and make a video call. He needed a lot of (4)____, because he often forgot which icon to press. Now the tablet helps him stay (8)____ to people he loves. Technology had once seemed (9)____ to him, but kindness and patience made it friendly. passages.title: The School Robot Contest
passages.text: Our school held a robot contest, and my team spent a month building a machine that could (1)____ to simple voice orders. passages.title: Being Polite in the Digital Age
passages.text: Technology has given us many fast ways to talk, but it has also raised new questions about how to be (1)____. When a message arrives, we feel we must (2)____ at once, even in the middle of a meal. Some people check their phones (3)____, glancing at the screen while a friend is still speaking. This habit can (4)____ the people around us, who feel ignored. Good manners online are much the same as in real life. We should not (5)____ that everyone is free the moment we send a text. It is kind to leave a clear (6)____ to a friend's question rather than a cold one-word reply. We should also be careful not to share someone's photo without asking, because that can hurt an (7)____ bond. The most (8)____ thing, perhaps, is to remember the person on the other side of the screen. Put the phone down (9)____, look up, and give the people in front of you your full (10)____.
